text_block_list.text:
We're currently discussing the training 
menu, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... My head feels like it's gonna split 
open...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine. I know a pressure 
point... that works on headaches~"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mom's on her feet all day for work, 
y'know? I used to massage her back a lot 
back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, I think on the back of the neck—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. This goes way beyond just finding 
the right pressure points.

Thanks to the headache, Nice Nature just 
wasn't her usual self...
